provision_inventory.anchor: Any person or agent thereof who threatens to or takes reprisals
provision_inventory.summary: Prohibits landlord threats or reprisals against residential tenants for reporting violations, exercising statutory rights, joining a tenant union, or paying rent to a unit owners association, and establishes liability for damages and attorney fees.
provision_inventory.reason: Anti-retaliation and reprisal protection for tenants; falls outside the six official categories.

provision_inventory.anchor: The receipt of any notice of termination of tenancy, except
provision_inventory.summary: Establishes a rebuttable presumption that notice of termination, rent increase, or substantial alteration in tenancy terms within six months of protected tenant activities is an unlawful reprisal.
provision_inventory.reason: Evidentiary presumption of retaliation; does not establish a just cause eviction scheme or limit how much or often rent may be increased.

provision_inventory.anchor: Any waiver of this provision in any lease or other
provision_inventory.summary: Declares any lease or rental agreement waiver of Section 18 void and unenforceable.
provision_inventory.reason: Anti-waiver provision for out-of-scope anti-retaliation law.
